detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Anonymous: visits, pages, sources, devices, countries. Sessions: also a random id per browser tab for bounce, duration and journeys. No IP address or cookie is kept.

retentionMonths.title: Keep raw events (months)
retentionMonths.description: Raw events are removed after this many months. Daily totals are kept.

requireConsent.title: Count only after analytics consent
requireConsent.description: Visits, events, searches and Web Vitals are recorded only once the visitor consents to analytics.

searchParams.title: Search query parameters
searchParams.description: Query parameters of your search results page, comma-separated (for example q, s). Empty: none.

recordCountry.title: Record the visitor's country (and city)
recordCountry.description: From your host’s country header; no IP address is kept.

toGa4.title: Also send Web Vitals to Google Analytics 4
toGa4.description: Each Web Vital also goes to Google Analytics 4 as an event, while Google Analytics is loaded.
